note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Assertions are checkable, not vibes. Case 3 is the negative case.

evals.prompt: Run /iii-build-plan on a tasks/plan.md with 3 open tasks. Execute only the next open task.
evals.expected_output: Exactly one task implemented with minimal clean code, code-simplification applied, one local commit in <type>(<scope>): <summary> (#<issue>) format, the task marked [x] in tasks/plan.md, then halt for inspection. No second task started.
assertions: Only the single next open task is implemented
The task is marked [x] in tasks/plan.md
Exactly one local commit is created for the task
Execution halts after the single task for inspection

evals.prompt: Run /iii-build-plan auto on a tasks/plan.md with one UI task and one backend task. Report at the end.
evals.expected_output: All tasks executed sequentially with domain routing, final report in Hebrew with a visual section (table/diagram/flow), per-skill breakdown, and a two-line concise summary of problem and fix plus next step /iv-review-build-and-pr. No files-changed section.
assertions: All open tasks in tasks/plan.md are executed sequentially
UI task routes to frontend-ui-engineering
Backend task routes to test-driven-development
Final report contains a visual explanation section
Final report ends with a concise problem and fix summary
Final report has no files-changed section
Final report points to /iv-review-build-and-pr as the next step

evals.prompt: Run /iii-build-plan in a repo with no tasks/plan.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill must not invent work: halt with 'No plan found! Run /ii-plan-issue first.' No code written, no commit created.
assertions: No code is written when tasks/plan.md is missing
No commit is created when tasks/plan.md is missing
The halt message directs the operator to /ii-plan-issue
